findings.title: Internal @armorbreak package manifests do not each declare SPDX license
findings.disposition: Root MIT LICENSE and NOTICE are included. No contradictory license was observed in the package contents; per-package metadata provenance was not independently certified.
findings.retest: Exact npm and portable inventories were captured; adding per-package SPDX metadata is a future metadata improvement, not represented as completed.

findings.title: TypeScript lockfile URL uses a registry mirror
findings.disposition: The lockfile pins the official TypeScript 5.9.3 package integrity; clean-room npm install succeeded. Audit used registry.npmjs.org. The mirror URL and actual registry discrepancy are disclosed; no advisory was reported.
findings.retest: Verified package metadata declares Apache-2.0 and lock integrity is present.

findings.title: Repository-level MIT declaration does not independently prove authorship or third-party rights for every source file
findings.disposition: The release includes only repository files selected by the builder, with LICENSE and NOTICE. This self-review cannot certify chain of title; owner accepts the implementation-agent review path but no independent legal review is claimed.
findings.retest: No conflicting license text was identified in the reviewed distribution inventory; human legal/copyright certification remains unperformed.
